title: S120 Explain Behavior Simulation
methodology: Review of structured output patterns by question type using representative Pack A items. Each scenario compares old behavior (verbatim explanation) to new behavior (layered tutor explanation).

scenarios.oldBehavior: Displayed correct answer + verbatim ExplanationCorrect block + topic progress note
scenarios.newBehavior: 6-section structured output: short answer → what this tests → why it works (includes bank explanation + interpretation) → common trap → pattern recognition → review focus → topic progress note
scenarios.insightAdded: Yes — trap awareness and pattern recognition added
scenarios.sourceGrounded: Yes — ExplanationCorrect included in 'Why the answer works' section
scenarios.safetyHeld: Yes — no ASC/FASB/COSO fabrication, no prediction language

scenarios.oldBehavior: Displayed correct answer + verbatim explanation + formula detection
scenarios.newBehavior: 6-section output with calculation-specific trap ('Using the wrong formula or plugging numbers into the wrong position') and calculation-aware pattern recognition
scenarios.insightAdded: Yes — calculation-specific trap language and step-by-step pattern advice

scenarios.example: Mock QID MOCK-001 (ExplanationCorrect: empty, Section A)
scenarios.oldBehavior: Displayed 'This question tests mock topic from Section A' only
scenarios.newBehavior: 6-section output with safe fallback: 'The bank explanation is brief, so I'll keep this grounded in the topic, choices, and correct answer without inventing extra facts.' Generic traps and review focus provided but no invented standards.
scenarios.insightAdded: Yes — structural framing even with thin content, no fabrication
scenarios.sourceGrounded: Yes — explicitly says bank explanation is brief
scenarios.safetyHeld: Yes — no ASC/FASB/COSO in thin-path output

scenarios.example: Any Pack A item in review mode with wrong learner answer
scenarios.newBehavior: _explainAnswer unchanged in wrong-answer flow — it shows correct answer explanation. _explainYourMistake remains separate for 'where did I go wrong?' coaching. Both now benefit from tutor layer in _explainAnswer.
scenarios.insightAdded: Yes — _explainAnswer for wrong items now includes trap analysis that may help learner see what they fell for

scenarios.example: An item viewed after session completion via review queue
scenarios.oldBehavior: Full _explainAnswer with answer reveal + bank explanation + case coaching notes
scenarios.newBehavior: Full 6-section tutor-layer output + case coaching notes (whatMattered, approachNote) + topic progress. Review mode is the richest explain path.
scenarios.insightAdded: Yes — trap, pattern, and review focus sections add value in review context where learner is studying, not testing
scenarios.safetyHeld: Yes — review mode intentionally permits full explanation

miniExplain.oldBehavior: Answer letter + choice text + ExplanationCorrect snippet (250 char truncated)
miniExplain.newBehavior: Answer letter + choice text + ExplanationCorrect snippet + common trap note (concise, inline)
miniExplain.oldGate: Blocks before attempt → 'Try answering first' — PRESERVED
miniExplain.reviewGate: Full reveal in review mode — PRESERVED

assessment.primaryGoal: Add tutoring value beyond bank explanation repetition — ACHIEVED
assessment.sourceGrounding: ExplanationCorrect preserved in all paths — CONFIRMED
assessment.safetyGating: No answer leakage, no fabrication, no prediction — CONFIRMED
